deviations_from_card: (1) Commit order is feat (recertify.cjs alone, then linga-text.cjs), then test, then package.json, then docs, so each commit is green. This follows the linga A / uat A precedent. Red-before was measured before any build: 6/6 red, with recertify.cjs absent. (2) metricDelta(before, after) counts each run whole, which case 2 requires (209/405). recertify.md calls it with {samePairs:true}, so before is counted over the pairs the rerun ran. For -lt vs -recert that gives 189/354, because -lt's J1 judges also counted topics. (3) A rerun lives inside the originating run as <run>/recert-<k>/. Its data and logs go under <run>/data/recert-<k>/ and <run>/logs/recert-<k>/, which the existing runs/*/data/ and runs/*/logs/ gitignore already covers, so .gitignore is untouched. The report is recertify.md, or recertify-<k>.md when that name is taken. 2026-09-15-lt already has a hand-written recertify.md, so its first automated recertify writes recertify-2.md. (4) The missing -> 'not-evaluable' status is kept in recertify_status, and resolution stays 'open', so the finding is still open and is never counted as fixed. Stamped rows carry recertify_run, recertify_status and recertify_evidence, plus recurred_as for a recurrence. (5) Added a code rule: 'not-seen' counts as fixed only when the journey ended 'done'. A crashed, stalled or abandoned journey turns the judge's not-seen into not-evaluable, per repo law that code decides. (6) Case 6's 'every row cites finding ids' is asserted for the four finding sections (Fixed, Still open, Regressed, New findings). Metric-delta and confound rows name the run pair and do not always cite ids. (7) Rerun finding ids stay positional (LT-<c>-<J>-<n>). recertify.md always writes them run-qualified (<run>/recert-<k>/LT-...), because they collide with the originating run's ids.
notes: Usage: node uat/driver/linga-text.cjs --recertify <run-id-or-abs-path> [character ...]. It cannot be combined with --run or --journeys. It exits 0 with 'Nothing open' when nothing is open. It was not run live on codex. An end-to-end smoke ran the real CLI on a temp copy of -recert2-beginners with all roles stubbed by a NODE_OPTIONS preload: a run.json was written, the prior rows went back into the copy's findings.json, recertify.md was written, and the setup-failed journeys correctly came out not-evaluable. Judge schema: prior[] uses minItems = maxItems = the number of prior ids, and id is an enum of those ids. The existing schema already used maxItems, but codex strict mode has not yet been seen to accept minItems. If a live judge call rejects the schema, drop minItems in judgeSchema(); code already treats a missing id as not-evaluable. Exports: linga-text.cjs now exports {actionIds, judgePayload, judgeRequest, judgeJourney, synthesize, JUDGE_SCREEN_CAP}. judgeSchema and judgeSystem moved to module scope. synthesize counts the rubric metrics through recertify.rollUp, so report.md and the delta cannot drift apart. It sorts a recurring gap above a new one of equal rank, and report.md shows 'recurs <id>, recurrence N'. Confound rules: a start confound fires when the share of real starts (a journey record with no 'fixture:' setup line) moves by more than 25% of the cast (START_SHIFT). A start confound, or a changed instrument, moves verdict drops out of Regressed and into Confounded. A metric regression is a fall of 10 or more points, marked 'weak evidence' when the base is under 5. On the committed runs, recertify of -lt against -recert moves the klara/martin/viktor J2 verdict drops into Confounded and lists moment precision 3/3 -> 22/27 as a weak-evidence regression. Committed runs under uat/runs/ were not modified: the suite hashes them before and after. The drain homes docs/uat-insights/ and docs/BACKLOG.md named in the README still do not exist. That is outside this card.
